findings.summary: Specialist AGT-SOC-HUNTER has no write/execute grants
findings.detail: Specialists are expected to perform actions. AGT-SOC-HUNTER has only read-class grants: siem_read, siem_tune, registry_read. Possibly mis-tiered as specialist when it should be a read-only advisor role, or missing the grants its job requires.
